question: Where is the breath-filled vital air said to be situated in living beings?
premises: The vital air is filled with breath
This air is present in all beings
It is described as situated within them
inference: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement between vāyuḥ and saṃsthitam is irregular in the transmitted form.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
